steps.label: ordered/parent
statements: CREATE TABLE OrderedParent(A INT64 NOT NULL,B INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(A,B)

steps.label: ordered/child
statements: CREATE TABLE OrderedChild(X INT64 NOT NULL,Y INT64 NOT NULL,V STRING(MAX),CONSTRAINT OrderedFk FOREIGN KEY(X,Y) REFERENCES OrderedParent(B,A)) PRIMARY KEY(X,Y)

steps.label: ordered/indexes
steps.sql: SELECT i.TABLE_SCHEMA,i.TABLE_NAME,i.INDEX_NAME,i.INDEX_TYPE,i.IS_UNIQUE,i.IS_NULL_FILTERED,i.INDEX_STATE,i.SPANNER_IS_MANAGED,c.COLUMN_NAME,c.ORDINAL_POSITION,c.COLUMN_ORDERING FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INDEXES AS i JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INDEX_COLUMNS AS c USING(TABLE_CATALOG,TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME) WHERE i.INDEX_TYPE='INDEX' AND i.TABLE_NAME IN ('OrderedChild','OrderedParent') ORDER BY i.TABLE_SCHEMA,i.TABLE_NAME,i.INDEX_NAME,c.ORDINAL_POSITION,c.COLUMN_NAME
